# Configuration reference

Every setting dictator has, generated from the schema that validates them.

Settings are layered, lowest precedence first:

1. Built-in defaults
2. `/etc/dictator/config.toml` — site-wide
3. `~/.config/dictator/config.toml` — yours
4. `DICTATOR_*` environment variables, e.g. `DICTATOR_MODEL_NAME=small`
5. `--set key=value` on the daemon command line

```bash
dictator config list          # effective values, and where each came from
dictator config set model.name small
dictator config sample        # a commented file you can start from
dictator config edit          # open yours in $EDITOR
```

Changes apply to a running daemon immediately; `dictator config set` reloads it.

## `[shortcuts]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dictate` | `Super+d` | — | Primary chord. Tap to toggle dictation; hold to dictate only while held. |
| `dictate_terminal` | *(unset)* | — | Optional chord that delivers using the terminal paste profile. Empty means unbound. Useful on Wayland, where the focused application cannot be detected automatically. |
| `cancel` | `Super+Escape` | — | Discard the utterance in flight, delivering nothing. |
| `hold_threshold_ms` | `250` | 0–2000 | A press shorter than this counts as a tap (toggle). Longer is a hold (push-to-talk, stops on release). |
| `backend` | `auto` | `auto` · `evdev` · `portal` · `x11` · `none` | Shortcut backend. 'auto' probes the session. |

## `[audio]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | *(unset)* | — | Input device by stable name. Empty means the system default. |
| `sample_rate` | `16000` | `8000` · `16000` · `22050` · `44100` · `48000` | Capture rate in Hz. Whisper wants 16000. |
| `preroll_ms` | `300` | 0–5000 | Audio retained before the chord registered, so the first word is not clipped. |
| `max_utterance_s` | `300` | 5–3600 | Hard ceiling on a single utterance. |
| `on_device_lost` | `fallback` | `fallback` · `fail` | What to do when the active device disappears mid-session. |

## `[vad]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | — | Segment speech so trailing silence is not decoded. |
| `silence_ms` | `700` | 100–5000 | Silence that closes a speech segment. |
| `threshold` | `0.02` | 0–1 | Energy threshold, 0-1, relative to full scale. |
| `min_speech_ms` | `150` | 0–2000 | Speech shorter than this is treated as noise. |

## `[model]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `auto` | — | Whisper model. 'auto' picks large-v3-turbo on CUDA, base on CPU. |
| `device` | `auto` | `auto` · `cuda` · `cpu` | Compute device. |
| `compute_type` | `auto` | `auto` · `int8` · `int8_float16` · `float16` · `float32` | Quantisation. 'auto' picks int8_float16 on CUDA, int8 on CPU. |
| `language` | `auto` | — | Force a language code, or 'auto' to detect. |
| `beam_size` | `5` | 1–10 | Decoder beam width. Higher is slower and slightly better. |
| `keep_resident` | `true` | — | Hold the model in memory between utterances. |
| `idle_unload_s` | `0` | 0–86400 | Unload after this many idle seconds. 0 disables. |
| `verify_digest` | `true` | — | Refuse to load model weights whose digest is not the pinned one. |

## `[streaming]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | — | Emit Partial results while the user is still speaking. |
| `interval_ms` | `400` | 100–5000 | Cadence of partial decodes. |
| `min_audio_ms` | `700` | 100–10000 | Do not attempt a partial until this much audio exists. |

## `[delivery]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `paste` | `paste` · `type` · `clipboard` | How text reaches the focused field. 'paste' is fastest and layout-safe; 'type' synthesises each character; 'clipboard' never synthesises input. |
| `clipboard` | `true` | — | Always place the transcript on the clipboard as well. |
| `restore_clipboard` | `true` | — | Restore the previous clipboard contents after pasting. |
| `restore_delay_ms` | `400` | 0–10000 | How long to wait before restoring the clipboard. |
| `default_profile` | `standard` | — | Paste profile used when the focused application cannot be identified. |
| `trailing_space` | `false` | — | Append a space to every delivered transcript. |
| `clipboard_only_apps` | `[]` | — | Applications that must never receive synthesised input. |

## `[memory]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | — | Persist transcripts to a searchable local store. |
| `retain_days` | `365` | 0–36500 | Delete transcripts older than this. 0 keeps them forever. |
| `store_audio` | `false` | — | Also retain the audio. Off by default: it makes the store far more sensitive. |
| `audio_retain_days` | `7` | 0–3650 | Retention for stored audio, when enabled. |
| `redact_patterns` | `[]` | — | Regexes whose matches are delivered but never stored. |

## `[lexicon]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | — | Bias the decoder toward known vocabulary. |
| `learn` | `false` | — | Grow the lexicon from observed corrections. |
| `max_prompt_terms` | `40` | 0–200 | Cap on terms injected as the decoder prompt. |

## `[ui]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tray` | `true` | — | Show the ambient tray indicator when a tray host exists. |
| `overlay` | `false` | — | Show live partial text in a small non-focusable overlay. |
| `notifications` | `true` | — | Send desktop notifications for faults and state changes. |
| `sounds` | `true` | — | Play a short cue when dictation starts and stops. |

## `[log]`

| Setting | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | `info` | `debug` · `info` · `warning` · `error` | Log verbosity. |
| `json` | `false` | — | Force JSON log output even on a terminal. |

## Shortcuts

| Id | What it does |
|---|---|
| `dictate` | Start or stop dictation (tap to toggle, hold to talk) |
| `dictate_terminal` | Dictate into a terminal |
| `cancel` | Discard the dictation in progress |

```bash
dictator keys set dictate "Super+d"
dictator keys check "Ctrl+Alt+Space"   # validate without binding
dictator keys conflicts               # what the desktop already claims
```

A chord needs at least one modifier that is not Shift, or it would capture
ordinary typing. `dictator keys check` refuses those with a reason.
